description:
I'm Ahmad Kura , a computer science graduate and AI engineer, leading Team Pandas. I want to build AI software with NASA data that actually works by the end of the weekend, with a focus on astronaut health on long missions.

Looking for: web developers, data analysts/visualizers, designers and storytellers for the demo, and anyone into health or human space exploration.

No need to be an expert. If you're curious, reliable and ready to build, join Team Pandas.
